sources.title: Signed circulants at the Ramanujan bound
observations: Conjecture 3 states the global-optimizer claim for every even n>=8.
The exhaustive verified range is n in {8,10,12,14,16,18}, with numerical agreement to 10^-9.
Proposition 1 gives spectral radius 2sqrt(2) for the all-unbalanced quadrilateral phase.
Remark 5 leaves the lower bound open and identifies reflection positivity as a natural route.
No revision, correction, n=32 remark, or counterexample appears in the accessed version.

observations: Provides the companion parity-family and kernel-averaging framework.
Uses short even cycles and traces as general spectral controls.
No Target A counterexample, n=32 result, period-8 classification, sharp radical, trichotomy, or target chiral reduction was found.

sources.title: Walks and eigenvalues of signed graphs
observations: Derives a sequence of signed-graph spectral-radius lower bounds expressed through walks or closed walks.
Does not use the Target A Hamilton-gauge periodic operator or state the N10 M1/M2/M3 formulas and motif inequalities.
Does not classify bounded-period signings as in N11.

sources.title: Measure-theoretic bounds on the spectral radius of graphs from walks
observations: Connects graph walk moments with spectral measures and derives spectral-radius bounds and necessary moment-support conditions.
Includes general moment-ratio inequalities, but not the N10 periodic signed-circulant motif identities or coefficients.
Does not address the N11 bounded primitive-period phase classification.
